title: IVG Smart Max Classic Menthol Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Classic Menthol delivers a clean and uncomplicated flavour with a brisk cooling effect. Smooth and refreshing from the first puff, this profile offers an easy-to-enjoy vape that’s ideal for those who prefer a no-nonsense Menthol experience without added fruit or sweetness. Each pod pack contains a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a separate 10ml refill reservoir. Once attached, the refill system feeds e-liquid automatically to support extended use, potentially delivering up to 10,000 puffs per kit depending on your vaping habits. No refilling or coil swaps needed. The pod features mesh coil technology for consistently smooth vapour and a reliable mouth-to-lung vape. Designed exclusively for use with the IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill and press firmly until they click together. Insert the connected pod and refill into the Smart Max device.
